items.name: Marble
items.headline: Expressive natural movement for refined interior surfaces.
items.summary: Marble brings distinctive veining and tonal movement to vanity tops, furniture surfaces, kitchen features, and architectural details. Each block and production lot is reviewed for color range, veining, finish, and fabrication behavior.
items.imageAlt: White marble surface with natural grey veining
items.maintenance: Use pH-neutral stone care, clean spills promptly, and maintain a sealer suited to the selected stone and exposure.
suitability: Wet areas with an agreed sealing plan
items.applicationAlt: Carrara marble kitchen island in a finished interior
items.caveat: Acid sensitivity, veining, fissures, and absorption vary by stone and lot. Review the physical sample and order-specific requirements before approval.

items.name: Granite
items.headline: Dense natural stone for demanding counters and project surfaces.
items.summary: Granite is commonly selected for working surfaces that need abrasion resistance and strong day-to-day performance. Mineral structure, finish, resin treatment, and exposure are reviewed for the exact material.
items.imageAlt: Granite surface with dense mineral pattern
items.maintenance: Use pH-neutral cleaner and review sealing requirements against the selected stone, finish, and use environment.
items.applicationAlt: Commercial counter application in a hospitality interior
items.caveat: Typical performance varies by geological source, finish, treatment, and batch. Review the selected stone, test report, and exposure before specification.

items.name: Quartz
items.headline: Repeatable visual direction for coordinated interior programs.
items.summary: Engineered quartz supports repeat vanity, kitchen, hospitality, and multi-family programs where color direction, sheet format, finish, and batch control are established before production.
items.imageAlt: Light engineered quartz surface with subtle movement
items.maintenance: Use non-abrasive pH-neutral cleaner and follow the selected product guidance for heat, chemicals, and stain removal.
items.applicationAlt: Engineered surface used on a modern kitchen island
items.caveat: Formulation, dimensions, finish, heat guidance, and technical properties are product-specific. Review the exact product sheet and physical sample.

items.name: Quartzite
items.headline: Dramatic natural pattern with project-specific material review.
items.summary: True quartzite combines expressive mineral movement with strong surface hardness. Geological identification, resin treatment, absorption, finish, and fabrication behavior are confirmed for the selected lot.
items.imageAlt: Quartzite-style natural stone surface with layered veining
items.maintenance: Use stone-safe products and establish sealing and stain-control requirements from the selected material and finish.
suitability: Wet areas by exact stone review
items.applicationAlt: Natural stone feature surface in a hospitality lobby
items.caveat: The trade name alone does not establish geology or performance. Verify identification, batch range, test data, and the physical sample before approval.

items.name: Travertine
items.headline: Linear movement and tactile character for furniture and interiors.
items.summary: Travertine is considered for furniture, architectural elements, and selected hospitality applications where pore structure, fill, finish, edge detail, and exposure are resolved together.
items.imageAlt: Fluted travertine dining surface with linear natural movement
items.maintenance: Use pH-neutral care products and maintain the specified sealer and fill system for the intended exposure.
suitability: Wet areas with a defined fill and sealing plan
items.applicationAlt: Rectangular travertine furniture surface in a finished interior
items.caveat: Open pores, fill, color movement, and edge behavior vary. Wet-area or exterior use requires review of the exact stone, fill system, finish, and project conditions.

items.name: Engineered Marble
items.headline: Coordinated interior surfaces for repeat vanity programs.
items.summary: Engineered marble is commonly reviewed for bathroom and hospitality programs where color direction, component construction, dimensions, and order documentation are controlled across repeat units.
items.imageAlt: Light engineered marble surface with fine grey movement
items.maintenance: Use non-abrasive pH-neutral care products and follow the exact product guidance for heat, chemicals, and stain removal.
items.applicationAlt: Engineered surface used in a multi-family bathroom vanity setting
items.caveat: Formulation, color range, dimensions, test documentation, and physical sample are reviewed for the exact product before production.
